Worker1.scope: House footprint is 7 blocks along X and 7 blocks along Z. Let X range from X_start to X_end (7 positions) and Z from Z_start to Z_end (7 positions). Define X_center as the central X column (ridge line), X_center = X_start + 3. Worker1 owns X_start..X_center across all Z for floor, walls, roof, and interior.
subtasks: Define the 7x7 footprint near the leader: choose X_start..X_end (7 blocks) along X and Z_start..Z_end (7 blocks) along Z. Compute X_center = X_start + 3 as the central ridge column. Keep this footprint as the outer boundary; do not extend the building beyond it except for optional 1-block roof overhangs.

Lightly level terrain ONLY within X_start..X_end and Z_start..Z_end so a base floor Y level is mostly flat. Remove or fill just enough blocks to support a continuous floor at Y_floor. Avoid deep digging or clearing outside the footprint.
Place the floor in your half: fill X_start..X_center and Z_start..Z_end at Y_floor with a consistent floor material (e.g., oak_planks). Ensure there are no gaps or drop-offs inside your region.

Build walls up to 3–4 blocks high: (a) complete the west outer wall along (X_start, Z_start..Z_end), and (b) build your segments of the north and south walls along (X_start..X_center, Z_start) and (X_start..X_center, Z_end). Keep the vertical edge at X_center flat and continuous so Worker2 can join cleanly.
Add vertical corner supports at the northwest (X_start, Z_start) and southwest (X_start, Z_end) corners using logs or another accent block if available, matching height with the main walls.
Create at least one small window opening (e.g., 1x2) in your section of either the north or south wall. Leave the opening empty unless glass or panes are available.

Construct the west half of a unified gable roof: starting from the top of your walls, place planks/stairs/slabs forming rows that slope UP from X_start toward the central ridge at X_center. For each Z from Z_start to Z_end, the roof must rise inward toward X_center so that the highest row in your half lies along X_center, forming your side of the shared ridge.

Stop all roof placement strictly at X_center: allow your highest roof blocks at X_center to form a straight ridge line that Worker2 will mirror from the east side. Do not extend roof blocks beyond X_center+0.5.

Add minimal interior within X_start..X_center: place at least one light source (torch/lantern) on an interior wall, and optionally one utility block (crafting table, furnace, or chest) against a wall to keep central space open.

Verify your half is enclosed: confirm continuous floor, walls up to full height, and roof coverage over your region, with only intentional openings for windows and the shared ridge join at X_center for Worker2.
Worker1.objective: Construct the west (negative X) half of the 7x7 house: half of the floor, the west outer wall, portions of north and south walls, and the west half of a unified roof that slopes toward a single center ridge; add minimal interior in that half.
Worker1.assumptions: Assume Worker2 will match your floor Y level (Y_floor), wall height, materials, and roof style, and will create the main entrance on the east side. Assume both workers have similar wooden building materials available.
Worker1.constraints: Do not place or break blocks east of X_center + 0.5. Do not modify terrain or structures outside the 7x7 footprint except for a uniform 1-block roof overhang if desired. Never remove or overwrite blocks placed by Worker2 along or beyond the X_center boundary once they appear.
Worker1.blockBreakLimit: Do not break more than 50 terrain blocks. Only break or replace blocks inside X_start..X_end and Z_start..Z_end that interfere with the floor, walls, or roof.

Worker2.scope: Use the same 7x7 footprint. Worker2 owns X_center..X_end across all Z for floor, walls, roof, and interior, joining seamlessly to Worker1’s structures along the central ridge at X_center.
subtasks: Read Worker1’s existing structure at X_center to determine the exact floor Y level (Y_floor), wall height, and materials. Match these values for your half.
Lightly level terrain ONLY within X_start..X_end and Z_start..Z_end in your half so your floor aligns smoothly with Worker1’s floor at Y_floor. Avoid breaking blocks outside the footprint.
Place the floor in your half: fill X_center..X_end and Z_start..Z_end at Y_floor with the same or visually compatible floor material used by Worker1.

Build walls up to the same 3–4 block height: (a) complete the east outer wall along (X_end, Z_start..Z_end), and (b) build your segments of the north and south walls along (X_center..X_end, Z_start) and (X_center..X_end, Z_end). Join directly to Worker1’s walls along X_center with no gaps or overlaps.
Add corner supports at the northeast (X_end, Z_start) and southeast (X_end, Z_end) corners, matching Worker1’s support style and material where possible.

Create the main entrance in your half, preferably along the south wall: carve a 1–2 block wide, 2-block tall doorway opening within X_center..X_end on Z = Z_start or Z = Z_end (choose the designated front side). Place a door if available; otherwise leave the opening clearly defined.
Add at least one window opening, aligning its sill/top height roughly with Worker1’s windows for symmetry.

Construct the east half of the unified gable roof: from the top of your walls, place planks/stairs/slabs that slope UP from X_end toward the central ridge at X_center. For each Z from Z_start to Z_end, ensure the slope converges exactly to the ridge line at X_center, connecting directly to Worker1’s highest roof blocks so the roof forms a single continuous peak.
Ensure the ridge at X_center is continuous: fill any gaps along X_center so that the roof line from Z_start to Z_end is fully sealed and at a consistent height.

Add interior elements within X_center..X_end: place at least one light source and one or two functional blocks (e.g., bed, crafting table, furnace, chest) against the walls, keeping a clear walking path from the entrance toward the center and into Worker1’s side.

Perform a final integrity check: verify continuous floor from X_start to X_end, sealed walls and unified roof with no unintended holes, and that only the door and window openings remain exposed. Ensure the building reads as a single cohesive house.
Worker2.objective: Construct the east (positive X) half of the 7x7 house: remaining floor, east outer wall, remaining north and south walls, the east half of the unified gable roof converging at the same central ridge, the main entrance, and interior elements on your side.
Worker2.assumptions: Assume Worker1 has stabilized the west half and defined base style decisions (material palette, wall height, and roof direction toward the central ridge at X_center) which you must mirror. Assume you are responsible for the main entrance and much of the functional interior.
Worker2.constraints: Do not modify or break blocks west of X_center - 0.5. Remain within the 7x7 footprint, allowing at most a uniform 1-block roof overhang. Avoid deleting or overwriting any blocks placed by Worker1, especially at the shared wall segments and along the central roof ridge at X_center.
Worker2.blockBreakLimit: Do not break more than 50 terrain blocks. Only break or replace blocks within X_start..X_end and Z_start..Z_end that obstruct your floor, walls, entrance, or roof.

body.buildingRequest: Build a complete small rectangular wooden house near the leader’s current position using two workers. The house must be enclosed and functional, with a continuous floor, solid walls, a full unified roof, at least one main entrance, a few windows, and basic interior (lighting and at least one utility/furnishing block like a bed, crafting table, furnace, or chest if available). Use an approximate footprint of 7x7 blocks (7 along X, 7 along Z). Prefer common wooden materials: planks for floor and walls, logs or another accent block for corners/frames, and planks/stairs/slabs for a simple gable roof that peaks along a single central ridge.
